why: Removing C8 eliminated a broad penalty against cutting before a ‘disambiguating stretch’, so the remaining constraints (e.g. predicate-argument and noun-internal rules) drive the model to place earlier/top-level cuts (rank_depth up at k=1,2). That helped very short pieces (bins ≤3–7) but caused more fragmentation of longer post‑modifier/disambiguating spans (bins >10 and overall decline).
lesson: When pruning a broad overlap-removing unit, keep an explicit, targeted safeguard for short disambiguating post-modifier stretches — otherwise the model will cut earlier and fragment longer modifier/PP stretches even as it helps short pieces.
